name: controle-de-fichas
description: Sistema de Controle de Fichas - Full Stack NestJS + Angular

scripts.build: cd backend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.install-all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build-frontend: cd frontend && npm run build -- --configuration production
scripts.validate:backend: cd backend && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build:nest
scripts.validate:audit: npm run audit:backend && npm run audit:frontend && npm run audit:agent
scripts.validate: npm run validate:backend && npm run validate:frontend && npm run validate:audit

author: Rodrigo Teixeira
